title: Please consider making claude-code fully open source
body:
Rationale:
* it will greatly speed up claude-code development and releases
  - looking at the positive reception
  - looking at the number of issues
* there is little to none confidential information/property on the client side
  - or can be moved server side
* it will greatly increase claude-code adoption
  - more features = better product = more users
* it will be good for anthropic (user-base, api usage, PR)
* it will significantly reduce any ai-suspicion/ai-anxious behaviour

Thank you for your consideration, and thank you kindly for initially releasing this valuable project.
author: rdslw
